note: Friend scene lines from the evil pack's second_rival.json (docs/plans/instrumentality/evil-pack/docs/SECOND_RIVAL.md). Tokens: {friend}, {player}, {rival}.

lines.line: You're {player}, right? Everyone's talking. I'm not impressed yet. Don't make me wait.
I heard about the raid. Not bad. If I'd been there it'd have been faster, but not bad.
Don't look so surprised! You think I'd miss the loudest fight in the region?
Your team composition is unusual. I'm {friend}. I'd like to see it in action.
I read the raid report. You made two good calls and one lucky one. Let's work on the lucky one.
I calculated the odds of you needing help. They were high. Here I am.
Oh, hi! I'm {friend}. Is your team okay? They look tired. Here, I have berries!
I heard it was scary. Are you alright? Really? You can tell me.
I couldn't just sit at home! Let me help. Please let me help.
{friend}. Don't bother introducing yourself; I read the standings. Try not to embarrass us both.
A raid. How noble. Next time, bring someone who can keep up.
Don't thank me. I'm here because the team ruined my favourite pier. That's all.
Oh! Your Pokémon's stance is unusual. Do you mind if I take notes? I'm {friend}.
Fascinating. The raid pattern matches a rural supply chain. Tell me what you saw.
I've reviewed the site plans. There are three exits. I'll hold the north one.
I'm {friend}. You'll have heard the name. I'd prefer you judged me on today.
My family would have paid the team off. I'd rather watch you do it properly.
I've come to help. No retinue, no name. Just me. Please call me {friend}.
...{friend}. I don't talk much. I watch. You're worth watching.
Raid. I saw the smoke. Good.
I'm here.
You walk like I walk. Funny. I'm {friend}. We should talk about that.
You handled the raid the way I would have. Which is either very good or very worrying.
I knew you'd be here. I'd have been here too. So I came.
